description: This file contains the implementation of a class 'DbStoredQueries' which provides access to SQL query templates and related utilities for Orleans' ADO.NET storage providers, including membership, reminders, streaming, and grain directory queries. It ensures the presence of required queries and exposes them as properties or methods, with conditional compilation for different storage-related features.

classes.name: DbStoredQueries
classes.description: Implements contract for stored SQL queries used in Orleans ADO.NET storage mechanisms, providing query validation, accessors, and conversion utilities.

methods.name: DbStoredQueries
methods.description: Constructor that verifies all required queries are present in the provided dictionary.

methods.name: Consolidated static class Converters
methods.description: Contains static methods for converting IDataRecord entries into Orleans-specific data structures and extracting query templates.
